# Anime4K

Unmodified mpv user shaders from [bloc97/Anime4K](https://github.com/bloc97/Anime4K)
(commit `7684e9586f8dcc738af08a1cdceb024cc184f426`), MIT license (see `LICENSE`).

`android/tools/anime4k_to_c.py` turns them into `android/native/frontend/anime4k_shaders.h`;
run it again after replacing a file here.
